card.name: Weight units in amounts and ratios
card.fires_on: The last piece of a weight unit such as milligram, gram, µg or mcg, or the word weight after "by". It also fires on "of" right after "per gram" or "1 gram".

modes.label: Gram-type unit endings
modes.description: The final letter or piece of a mass unit after a number, often in a per-kg or per-amount expression.
modes.example: g/kg/day Manganese** - 1 mc<<g>>/kg/day *Multrys is not recommended

modes.label: By weight
modes.description: The word weight in "by weight" when giving a percentage or dosing table basis.
modes.example: Dietary protein is approximately 16% nitrogen by<< weight>>. Given that approximately 47%

modes.label: Of after gram
modes.description: The word "of" following a gram amount, leading into the substance.
modes.example: To measure 1 gram<< of>> lidocaine and prilocaine cream
